items.evidence: evidence-pack.md#L33 (story.md#L24, no distinguishing signal); evidence-pack.md#L48-L51 (ux-copy.md#L3-L6, message-to-outcome pairing)
items.note: The pack indeed never states how off-copy text should be classified for AC-2 counting; story.md#L24 names "success and failure" without a distinguishing signal, and ux-copy.md pairs each outcome with exactly one message but is silent on mismatches. Correctly marked resolution="assumed", and the proposed classification (recognise outcome only by its exact approved message) is a direct, non-arbitrary application of R2/R3 rather than an invented behaviour.

summary: The two acceptance criteria and rules R1/R3 are verbatim, fully grounded extractions with no added or dropped conditions, and gaps G4/G5 are genuine (not resolvable from the sources) and honestly labelled as assumptions rather than discovered values. R2 is substantively correct but cites only ux-copy.md#L3 (the table header) as its source when the actual quoted values sit at L5 and L6, which the contract's own coverage ledger elsewhere gets right.
